SELECT uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS users
FROM analytics_events
WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
  AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
  AND platform = 'IOS'

SELECT round(avg(dau), 0) AS avg_dau
FROM
  (SELECT
     event_date,
     uniqExact(user_pseudo_id) AS dau
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
     AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND platform = 'IOS'
   GROUP BY event_date)

SELECT round(avg(max_engagement_msec) / 1000, 1) AS avg_sec
FROM
  (SELECT
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id,
     max(param_engagement_time_msec) AS max_engagement_msec
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
     AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND platform = 'IOS'
     AND event_name = 'user_engagement'
     AND param_engagement_time_msec > 0
   GROUP BY
     user_pseudo_id,
     param_ga_session_id)

WITH
  errors AS
  (SELECT
     event_date,
     count(*) AS error_count
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
     AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND platform = 'IOS'
     AND event_name IN (__ALL_ERROR_EVENTS__)
   GROUP BY event_date),
  sessions AS
  (SELECT
     event_date,
     count(*) AS session_count
   FROM analytics_events
   WHERE import_dataset = '${app_dataset}'
     AND event_date >= toDate('${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND event_date <= toDate('${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}')
     AND platform = 'IOS'
     AND event_name = 'session_start'
   GROUP BY event_date)
SELECT
  s.event_date AS TIME,
  round(coalesce(e.error_count, 0) * 1.0 / greatest(s.session_count, 1), 4) AS errors_per_session
FROM sessions s
LEFT JOIN errors e ON s.event_date = e.event_date
ORDER BY TIME
